note: A plain-language index of the main obligations, by role. It points to the articles; it does not replace them. Check the consolidated text before relying on any line.

tiers.title: Prohibited practices (Article 5)
tiers.max_fine: EUR 35 million or 7% of worldwide annual turnover, whichever is higher

tiers.title: Most other obligations on providers, deployers and others
tiers.max_fine: EUR 15 million or 3% of worldwide annual turnover, whichever is higher

tiers.title: Supplying incorrect, incomplete or misleading information to authorities
tiers.max_fine: EUR 7.5 million or 1% of worldwide annual turnover, whichever is higher

obligations.title: Support AI literacy
obligations.summary: Take measures that support AI literacy among staff and others who operate or use AI systems on your behalf.

obligations.title: Do not place on the market or use prohibited AI practices
obligations.summary: Stay clear of the Article 5 list, which includes manipulative techniques, social scoring and certain biometric uses. New prohibitions apply from 2 December 2026.

obligations.title: Meet the transparency duties
obligations.summary: Tell people when they are interacting with an AI system, mark synthetic content, and disclose deepfakes and certain emotion recognition or biometric categorisation.

obligations.title: Build and document high-risk systems
obligations.summary: Run a risk management system, govern data, keep technical documentation and logs, provide instructions, design for human oversight, accuracy and robustness, and operate a quality management system.

obligations.title: Complete conformity assessment, declaration and registration
obligations.summary: Carry out the conformity assessment, draw up the EU declaration of conformity, affix the CE marking and register the system.

obligations.title: Monitor after market placement and report serious incidents
obligations.summary: Keep a post-market monitoring system and report serious incidents to the market surveillance authority.

obligations.title: Use high-risk systems as instructed, with oversight
obligations.summary: Follow the instructions for use, assign competent human oversight, keep the logs you control, monitor operation and inform affected workers and people where required.

obligations.title: Assess fundamental rights impact where Article 27 applies
obligations.summary: Public bodies, providers of public services and deployers of certain credit and insurance systems carry out a fundamental rights impact assessment before first use.

obligations.title: Document the model and respect copyright
obligations.summary: Keep technical documentation, give downstream providers the information they need, adopt a copyright compliance policy and publish a training content summary.

obligations.title: Manage systemic risk for the most capable models
obligations.summary: Models with systemic risk add model evaluation, adversarial testing, risk mitigation, serious incident reporting and cybersecurity protection.
